title: a person outside an open market joins its waitlist

criteria.text: Every US zip resolves to a market before launch; nothing is selected from a list
criteria.note: Restated 2026-10-11 (F103). `zip_county` and `counties` hold the national Census ZCTA table; `zip_market_key()` resolves a zip, a county no market names is its own waiting market; a PO-box-only zip with no ZCTA is unknown and refused (Census now, HUD-USPS later, PM 2026-10-12) [V migration 20261012030000]. Built by F103 #709: `review-skipped`; deploy-health success on 4f571f5c [V]. Checked no: only `[guards F103.n partial]` markers and a stale `[guards F076.1 partial]`. #843. Smoked unknown: sign-up is not a smoke route.

criteria.text: The platform never selects a market for the person: no IP, default, nearest match or shortlist; the zip decides
criteria.note: Restated 2026-10-11. `[guards F076.2]` in `tests/f076-never-rules.test.ts` scans the waitlist, onboarding and explore surfaces for IP, geolocation, distance and pre-checked controls (and checks it can see them) [V]. No IP guess exists in src: the "Is this your area?" flow (F081 ruling 2026-10-11, #588) is unbuilt, and the PM's 2026-10-12 ruling on F105 says nothing is picked for a visitor, so I read them as compatible [V grep, A]. Reviewed no (#709 `review-skipped`); shipped yes (4f571f5c).

criteria.text: The waitlist entry records make or find, neither pre-selected; no role on the member; the answer is discarded when the market opens
criteria.note: Built half: `metro_waitlist.role`, no default, no pre-selected radio, no role column on any member table [V]; `[guards F076.3]` scans migrations for member role columns. Missing: discarding the role when the market opens. Nothing writes `is_open` and nothing deletes waitlist rows; opening is a raw database update [V grep]. #616 lists it as missing item 3. Checked no: the guard does not cover the discard.

criteria.text: One person counts once in one market, whether they signed up or only left an email
criteria.note: Member row unique by `member_id`; address row unique by `lower(email)` across all markets; a member who had left an address is folded into the member row (#763, #613) [V handlers]. `[guards F076.4]` x2 in `waitlist-join.test.ts` (SQL-call level, mocked database) plus a partial for the reverse order [V]. Reviewed no: #86, #191, #197 have no `Reviewed by:` (#763 does). Shipped unknown: no deploy-health run for 640e1fc2 (#86).

criteria.text: Changing the market moves the count; neither double-counted nor stranded
criteria.note: Both handlers update the row and move the counter in one transaction [V]. `[guards F076.5]` in `f076-criteria.test.ts` runs the move through both ways of joining (mocked database; mutants run by hand, #766) [V]. Built by #86, #191, #197: no `Reviewed by:`; deploy-health unknown for #86.

criteria.text: Creator and patron counts are stored separately and readable apart
criteria.note: `metro_polygons.creator_count` and `patron_count` (and the same on `markets`) [V migrations]. `[guards F076.6]` in `f076-criteria.test.ts` for both paths [V]. Built by #86; reviewed no, shipped unknown.

criteria.text: After joining, a popup shows a count and a message, for everyone, from the cache
criteria.note: Built half: both actions call `waitingCountFor` (#217, #764) and the panel opens a dialog [V]. Missing: `getMetroWaitingCounts` is an `unstable_cache` whose function calls `createClient()`, which reads `cookies()`; Next refuses that, so the popup action throws after the row is written [V src/lib/metro/waitlist-counts.ts, supabase-server.ts; runtime failure reported on #686, not reproduced today, A]. #764 made the signed-in path call the same function, so it is affected too [A]. Checked no: only partial markers, and the tests mock `waitingCountFor`. #686.

criteria.text: One combined number against 300, the same figure everywhere
criteria.note: The combined figure and target exist (`standingFromCombined`, 300) [V]. Missing: the one cached read throws (see 7), and `load.ts` swallows it into an empty map. Since 2026-10-11 the only other surface that should show it is a waiting vantage (F105 criterion 4, #699, deferred), unbuilt. Checked no: partial marker. #686, #699.

criteria.text: The message says what is still needed and never a date, a timeline or a promise
criteria.note: `standingMessage` in `waitlist-standing.ts`; `[guards F076.9]` asserts no date or promise wording [V]. New wording sits in draft PR #684 (do not merge) and is Don's to approve. Built by #86; reviewed no, shipped unknown.

criteria.text: A market is eligible only at 50 creators and 250 patrons; 300 combined with fewer than 50 creators is not enough
criteria.note: `metroStanding` gates on creators and patrons separately; `[guards F076.10]` as one table [V]. Built by #86; reviewed no, shipped unknown.

criteria.text: Thresholds are configurable per market without a migration or a deploy
criteria.note: Threshold columns on `metro_polygons` and `markets`; `[guards F076.11]` scans for hard-coded thresholds and reads the column defaults [V]. Built by #86; reviewed no, shipped unknown.

criteria.text: Opening a market is deliberate; crossing the threshold never opens it
criteria.note: No application code writes `is_open`; `[guards F076.12]` scans src, scripts and every migration except the two seeds [V]. Note: because nothing opens a market, the opening itself is a raw SQL update today (see #616).

criteria.text: A person can leave an email to be told when a market opens, with no account
criteria.note: `metro.waitlist_join_anonymous` and `MetroNotCoveredPanel`: address and role only, no password or name, one tap [V]. `[guards F076.13]` drives the panel and asserts the exact call [V]. The row is written; the confirmation popup then fails (#686). Built by #197, #198: no `Reviewed by:`; deploy-health success on 0ac5c54f and 8ad3ee56. Smoked unknown: the panel is reached only by picking a waiting market, which the smoke does not do.

criteria.text: The response is identical whether or not the address was already there, the number included
criteria.note: The result type has no changed or created flag and no count; the number is the cached figure, not a function of the submission [V]. `[guards F076.14]` runs the handler on a real database for a new, a repeated and another known address and expects byte-identical results, and scans that no other code reads the live counters [V]. While #686 stands the number never appears, so the end-to-end response is untested at the screen [A]. Reviewed no (#197); shipped yes (0ac5c54f, a3faf37c).

criteria.text: An address is used only to say the market opened, then discarded
criteria.note: Addresses are stored and the panel states the single use; nothing reads them back, no mail library is in the project, nothing deletes them [V grep]. The PM chose Resend and the wording on #616 (2026-10-11). Missing: the send, the discard, and a deliberate way to open a market that triggers both. #616 (open, Beta 11-06).

criteria.text: Metros are ordered by how many people are waiting
criteria.note: Struck 2026-10-11 (F103 ruling, in the scenario): there is no list of markets to order, since the zip decides. The surviving rule, that no surface reads the live counters, is under criteria 8 and 14. Shown, not counted.
